Title: General Availability: Azure Automation supports PowerShell 7.2 runbooks

Body.Content:
Azure Automation announces General Availability of PowerShell 7.2 runbooks. You can easily author runbooks in the long-term supported version of PowerShell, using Azure Automation extension for VS code (powered with GitHub Copilot), and execute them on a secure and reliable platform. 

Learn more about PowerShell 7.2 runbooks.

Note: PowerShell 7.1 is no longer supported by parent product PowerShell. It is strongly recommended to create PowerShell 7.2 runbooks for long-term support.
